FIXED AMOUNT OF CENTRAL EXCISE DUTY ON CATERERS RULES, 1996
FIXED AMOUNT OF CENTRAL EXCISE DUTY ON CATERERS
RULES, 1996
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 13th June,
1996]
S.R.O. 461(1)/96, dated 13‑6‑1996.‑‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by subsections (8) and (9) of section 3 of the
Central Excises Act, 1944 (1 of 1944) read with section 37 thereof, the Central
Board of Revenue, with the prior approval of Federal Government, is pleased to
make the following rules, for the
collection of fixed amount of central excise duty from the caterers liable to
pay duty in lieu of central excise duty
leviable thereon under subsection (1) of the said section, namely---
1. Short title, application and commencement.‑‑‑(1)
These rules may be called the Fixed Amount of Central Excise Duty on Caterers Rules,
1996.
(2) They shall, unless earlier rescinded, remain in force
during the financial year 1996‑97.
(3) They shall apply to all caterers as defined in clause
(6) of section 2 of the Central Excises Act, 1944. ,
2. Definitions.‑‑In these Rules, unless there
is anything repugnant in the subject or context, ‑‑‑
(a) "Act" means the Central Excises Act, 1944 (I
of 1944);
(b) "Assistant Collector" means the Assistant
Collector of Central Excise in whose jurisdiction the catering business is
situated:
Provided that where there is no Assistant Collector, it
shall mean the Deputy Collector of Central Excise in whose jurisdiction the
catering business is situated;
(c) "Association" means the respective
association of caterers;
(d) "financial year 1996‑97" means the
year commencing from the 1st July, 1996, and ending on 30th June, 1997;
(e) "Joint survey committee" means the joint
survey committee constituted under sub‑rule (3) of rule 4;
(f) "Superintendent of Central Excise" means the
Superintendent of Central Excise in whose jurisdiction the catering business is
situated.
(2) All other expressions used but not defined in these
rules shall have the meanings assigned to them under the Act and the rules made
thereunder.
3. Caterer to obtain licence, ‑‑Every caterer
shall, before commencing the catering business, obtain a licence in terms of
the rules as contained in Chapter VIII of the Central Excise Rules, 1944.
4. Declaration to be made.‑‑(11 Every caterer
shall make a declaration in the form annexed to these Rules to the Assistant
Collector within fifteen days of the issuance of these Rules, for the financial
year 1996‑97‑
Provided that where a caterer has more than one branch for
providing or rendering such services, he shall submit the declaration, separately
for each such branch, to the respective Assistant Collector.
(2) The declaration made under sub‑rule (11 shall
remain in force during the financial year 1996‑97 unless the declaration
is revoked by the caterer as a result of permanent closure of catering
business;
Provided that the caterer shall inform, in writing, about
closure of business to the Assistant Collector at least fifteen days before
such closure.
(3) The declaration made under sub‑rule (1) shall be
verified by joint survey committee comprising at least one nominee of the
respective Association, the Assistant Collector and the caterer or his nominee.
(4) Any person, undertaking or establishment intending to
commence the catering business during the course of financial year for the first
time shall apply, alongwith the declaration under sub‑rule (1), in
writing to the Assistant Collector, fifteen days before such commencement.
5. Rates which the fixed duty shall be paid.‑‑(1)
A caterer shall pay the annual amount of fixed duty in respect of his catering
business at the rates specified in column (4) of the table.
(2) A caterer who
has more than one branch for providing or Caterers Rules, 1996 rendering the
services shall pay the aforesaid rate of duty separately for each such branch.
(3) The fixed amount of duty shall be paid by the caterer
in equal monthly instalments payable on or before the 25th day of the month
